notes: Forensic sheets at f0685 (entry), f0694 (pre-contact), f0704 (contact), f0713 (post-contact) and f0723 (exit) all show the Red Bull floor logo holding its position correctly as the player walks across it. The 'suspected leak overlay' column confirms masking is mostly working — the logo does not bleed through the player's legs in any of the five sheets. The composite column reads cleanly at entry/pre-contact/exit. The weakest moment is at contact (f0704) and post-contact (f0713): the player's shoes appear above the logo as expected, but the logo itself stays uniformly bright underneath where in the original there would be a darkening contact shadow under and around the foot. That is the single biggest tell that the logo is rendered rather than painted. Geometry, scale and tracking are excellent throughout the 685–723 window with no visible jitter. Hue match to the surrounding court is essentially perfect.
